      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      opacity: 0.72;
    }

    .credit {
      position: fixed;
      right: 18px;
      top: 16px;
      color: rgba(70, 65, 54, 0.55);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .caption {
        left: 14px;
        bottom: 14px;
      }

      .credit {
        display: none;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="caption">
    <h1>Brittle Star</h1>
    <p>Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom · Double-click to reset</p>
  </div>
  <div class="credit">Procedural Three.js study</div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xe7e3d8);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xe7e3d8, 18, 38);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      innerWidth / innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive three-dimensional brittle star resting on a barrel sponge"
    );
    document.body.prepend(renderer.domElement);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8e8, 0x777367, 2.25);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4dc, 4.2);
    keyLight.position.set(7, 12, 6);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -12;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 12;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 12;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -12;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 32;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xc8d9e3, 1.25);
    fillLight.position.set(-8, 5, -7);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffe8bd, 24, 25, 2);
    rimLight.position.set(1, 5, -7);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural textures
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    let seed = 81273;
    function random() {
      seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
      return seed / 4294967296;
    }

    function makeSpongeTextures() {
      const size = 1024;
      const colorCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      const bumpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      colorCanvas.width = colorCanvas.height = size;
      bumpCanvas.width = bumpCanvas.height = size;

      const colorContext = colorCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const bumpContext = bumpCanvas.getContext("2d");

      const baseGradient = colorContext.createRadialGradient(
        size * 0.45,
        size * 0.42,
        size * 0.05,
        size * 0.5,
        size * 0.5,
        size * 0.7
      );
      baseGradient.addColorStop(0, "#d7c69f");
      baseGradient.addColorStop(0.55, "#c9b78d");
      baseGradient.addColorStop(1, "#bda77c");
      colorContext.fillStyle = baseGradient;
      colorContext.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      const bumpContextFill = bumpContext.createRadialGradient(
        size * 0.45,
        size * 0.42,
        size * 0.05,
        size * 0.5,
        size * 0.5,
        size * 0.7
      );
      bumpContextFill.addColorStop(0, "rgb(125,125,125)");
      bumpContextFill.addColorStop(0.55, "rgb(95,95,95)");
      bumpContextFill.addColorStop(1, "rgb(55,55,55)");
      bumpContext.fillStyle = bumpContextFill;
      bumpContext.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Soft, irregular pores.
      for (let i = 0; i < 1500; i++) {
        const x = random() * size;
        const y = random() * size;
        const radius = 5 + random() * 58;
        const darkness = 0.24 + random() * 0.42;

        const poreGradient = colorContext.createRadialGradient(
          x,
          y,
          0,
          x,
          y,
          radius
        );
        poreGradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(77, 62, 40, ${darkness})`);
        poreGradient.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(91, 76, 51, ${darkness * 0.55})`);
        poreGradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(145, 129, 91, 0)");

        colorContext.fillStyle = poreGradient;
        colorContext.beginPath();
        colorContext.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        colorContext.fill();

        const bumpGradient = bumpContext.createRadialGradient(
          x,
          y,
          0,
          x,
          y,
          radius
        );
        bumpGradient.addColorStop(0, "rgba(45,45,45,0.8)");
        bumpGradient.addColorStop(0.55, "rgba(75,75,75,0.4)");
        bumpGradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(125,125,125,0)");
        bumpContext.fillStyle = bumpGradient;
        bumpContext.beginPath();
        bumpContext.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        bumpContext.fill();
      }

      // Small raised fibers and pits add texture at distance.
      for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) {
        const x = random() * size;
        const y = random() * size;
        const radius = 1 + random() * 4;

        colorContext.fillStyle = `rgba(255,244,214,${0.08 + random() * 0.16})`;
        colorContext.beginPath();
        colorContext.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        colorContext.fill();
      }

      const colorMap = new THREE.CanvasTexture(colorCanvas);
      colorMap.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      colorMap.wrapS = colorMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      colorMap.repeat.set(2.6, 2.2);
      colorMap.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      const bumpMap = new THREE.CanvasTexture(bumpCanvas);
      bumpMap.wrapS = bumpMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      bumpMap.repeat.copy(colorMap.repeat);
      bumpMap.anisotropy = colorMap.anisotropy;

      return { colorMap, bumpMap };
    }

    function makeBrittleTextures() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 512;
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");

      context.fillStyle = "#a8a499";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 1800; i++) {
        const x = random() * 512;
        const y = random() * 512;
        const radius = 0.5 + random() * 3.2;
        const light = random() > 0.45;

        context.fillStyle = light
          ? `rgba(235,229,211,${0.12 + random() * 0.3})`
          : `rgba(66,62,55,${0.08 + random() * 0.22})`;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fill();
      }

      const map = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      map.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      map.wrapS = map.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      map.repeat.set(2, 2);
      map.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      const bumpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      bumpCanvas.width = bumpCanvas.height = 512;
      const bumpContext = bumpCanvas.getContext("2d");

      bumpContext.fillStyle = "#808080";
      bumpContext.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      for (let i = 0; i < 1200; i++) {
        const x = random() * 512;
        const y = random() * 512;
        const radius = 0.5 + random() * 2.4;

        bumpContext.fillStyle = random() > 0.5
          ? "rgba(45,45,45,0.45)"
          : "rgba(155,155,155,0.35)";

        bumpContext.beginPath();
        bumpContext.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        bumpContext.fill();
      }

      const bumpMap = new THREE.CanvasTexture(bumpCanvas);
      bumpMap.wrapS = bumpMap.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      bumpMap.repeat.copy(map.repeat);
      bumpMap.anisotropy = map.anisotropy;

      return { map, bumpMap };
    }

    const spongeTextures = makeSpongeTextures();
    const brittleTextures = makeBrittleTextures();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Barrel sponge
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const spongeProfile = [
      new THREE.Vector2(0.00, 0.00),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.45, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.35, 0.38),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.90, 0.92),
      new THREE.Vector2(3.12, 1.65),
      new THREE.Vector2(3.24, 2.45),
      new THREE.Vector2(3.25, 3.02),
      new THREE.Vector2(3.14, 3.38),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.96, 3.61),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.68, 3.70),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.38, 3.61),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.15, 3.35),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.02, 2.95),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.96, 2.38),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.04, 1.82),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.22, 1.28),
      new THREE.Vector2(2.55, 0.83),
      new THREE.Vector2(3.00, 0.38),
      new THREE.Vector2(3.18, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector2(3.08, 0.04),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.00, 0.04)
    ];

    const spongeGeometry = new THREE.LatheGeometry(spongeProfile, 128);
    const spongePositions = spongeGeometry.attributes.position;

    // Slight organic irregularity in the sponge silhouette.
    for (let i = 0; i < spongePositions.count; i++) {
      const x = spongePositions.getX(i);
      const y = spongePositions.getY(i);
      const z = spongePositions.getZ(i);
      const radius = Math.hypot(x, z);

      if (radius > 0.01) {
        const angle = Math.atan2(z, x);
        const distortion =
          1 +
          0.022 * Math.sin(angle * 5 + y * 1.8) +
          0.012 * Math.sin(angle * 11 - y * 2.4);

        spongePositions.setXYZ(
          i,
          x * distortion,
          y + 0.012 * Math.sin(angle * 3.2),
          z * distortion
        );
      }
    }

    spongeGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

    const spongeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,
      map: spongeTextures.colorMap,
      bumpMap: spongeTextures.bumpMap,
      bumpScale: 0.075,
      roughness: 0.98,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const sponge = new THREE.Mesh(spongeGeometry, spongeMaterial);
    sponge.castShadow = true;
    sponge.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(sponge);

    // A slightly lighter rolled edge around the top of the sponge.
    const rim = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(3.08, 0.17, 14, 128),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xd5c39a,
        map: spongeTextures.colorMap,
        bumpMap: spongeTextures.bumpMap,
        bumpScale: 0.045,
        roughness: 0.96
      })
    );
    rim.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    rim.position.y = 3.53;
    rim.scale.y = 0.9;
    rim.castShadow = true;
    rim.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(rim);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Brittle star central disc
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const discGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.78, 48, 28);
    const discPositions = discGeometry.attributes.position;

    for (let i = 0; i < discPositions.count; i++) {
      const x = discPositions.getX(i);
      const y = discPositions.getY(i);
      const z = discPositions.getZ(i);

      const irregularity =
        1 +
        0.035 * Math.sin(x * 7.3 + z * 4.1) +
        0.022 * Math.cos(z * 9.7 - x * 2.4);

      discPositions.setXYZ(
        i,
        x * irregularity,
        y * 0.32 + 0.018 * Math.sin(x * 5 + z * 3),
        z * irregularity
      );
    }

    discGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

    const disc = new THREE.Mesh(
      discGeometry,
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xb5b0a3,
        map: brittleTextures.map,
        bumpMap: brittleTextures.bumpMap,
        bumpScale: 0.035,
        roughness: 0.88
      })
    );
    disc.position.set(0, 3.84, 0);
    disc.castShadow = true;
    disc.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(disc);

    // A small central knob gives the disc a natural focal point.
    const centralKnob = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.18, 20, 12),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x8d8980,
        map: brittleTextures.map,
        bumpMap: brittleTextures.bumpMap,
        bumpScale: 0.03,
        roughness: 0.9
      })
    );
    centralKnob.position.set(0, 4.08, 0);
    centralKnob.scale.y = 0.7;
    centralKnob.castShadow = true;
    scene.add(centralKnob);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Five long, jointed, tapering arms
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const armDefinitions = [
      { angle: 0.20, length: 7.7, droop: 0.55 },
      { angle: 1.35, length: 8.4, droop: 0.76 },
      { angle: 2.50, length: 7.9, droop: 0.61 },
      { angle: 3.65, length: 8.9, droop: 0.88 },
      { angle: 4.85, length: 7.5, droop: 0.64 }
    ];

    const armMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xb2ada0,
      map: brittleTextures.map,
      bumpMap: brittleTextures.bumpMap,
      bumpScale: 0.035,
      roughness: 0.9
    });

    const jointMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x817d72,
      map: brittleTextures.map,
      bumpMap: brittleTextures.bumpMap,
      bumpScale: 0.025,
      roughness: 0.92
    });

    const armCurves = [];
    const armJointPositions = [];

    for (const definition of armDefinitions) {
      const angle = definition.angle;
      const length = definition.length;
      const droop = definition.droop;

      const points = [
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * 0.34,
          3.80,
          Math.sin(angle) * 0.34
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * 0.95,
          3.86,
          Math.sin(angle) * 0.95
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * 2.05,
          3.80,
          Math.sin(angle) * 2.05
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * 3.38,
          3.50,
          Math.sin(angle) * 3.38
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * length * 0.52,
          2.82 - droop * 0.12,
          Math.sin(angle) * length * 0.52
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * length * 0.72,
          1.35 - droop * 0.18,
          Math.sin(angle) * length * 0.72
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * length * 0.88,
          0.55 - droop * 0.16,
          Math.sin(angle) * length * 0.88
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * (length - 0.35),
          0.20 - droop * 0.08,
          Math.sin(angle) * (length - 0.35)
        ),
        new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(angle) * (length - 0.82),
          0.34 - droop * 0.04,
          Math.sin(angle) * (length - 0.82)
        )
      ];

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
        points,
        false,
        "catmullrom",
        0.5
      );
      armCurves.push(curve);

      // Constant-radius TubeGeometry is then tapered toward the tip.
      const tubeGeometry = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 110, 0.13, 7, false);
      const positions = tubeGeometry.attributes.position;

      for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
        const t = i / (positions.count - 1);
        const x = positions.getX(i);
        const y = positions.getY(i);
        const z = positions.getZ(i);
        const radialLength = Math.hypot(x, y, z);

        if (radialLength > 0.0001) {
          const taper =
            1 - 0.30 * t + 0.035 * Math.sin(t * 25 + definition.angle * 4);

          positions.setXYZ(
            i,
            x / radialLength / taper,
            y / radialLength / taper,
            z / radialLength / taper
          );
        }
      }

      tubeGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

      const arm = new THREE.Mesh(tubeGeometry, armMaterial);
      arm.castShadow = true;
      arm.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(arm);

      // Bulbous nodes make the arm visibly jointed.
      for (const t of [0.05, 0.22, 0.39, 0.57, 0.74, 0.89]) {
        const point = curve.getPointAt(t);
        armJointPositions.push({
          position: point,
          scale: new THREE.Vector3(
            0.16 * (1 - 0.24 * t),
            0.17 * (1 - 0.24 * t),
            0.16 * (1 - 0.24 * t)
          )
        });
      }
    }

    // Instanced joint nodes.
    const jointGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 14, 10);
    const joints = new THREE.InstancedMesh(
      jointGeometry,
      jointMaterial,
      armJointPositions.length
    );
    joints.castShadow = true;
    joints.receiveShadow = true;

    const transform = new THREE.Object3D();
    armJointPositions.forEach((joint, index) => {
      transform.position.copy(joint.position);
      transform.scale.copy(joint.scale);
      transform.updateMatrix();
      joints.setMatrixAt(index, transform.matrix);
    });

    scene.add(joints);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Small spines along the arms and disc
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const spineData = [];

    for (const curve of armCurves) {
      const tubeGeometry = curve.geometry;
      const positions = tubeGeometry.attributes.position;
      const normals = tubeGeometry.attributes.normal;

      for (let index = 0; index < positions.count; index += 5) {
        const t = (index + 2) / (positions.count - 1);
        const point = curve.getPointAt(t);
        const normal = normals.getY(index). === undefined
          ? new THREE.Vector3()
          : new THREE.Vector3(
              normals.getX(index),
              normals.getY(index),
              normals.getZ(index)
            ).normalize();

        spineData.push({
          position: point.clone().addScaledVector(normal, 0.025),
          normal,
          scale: 0.72 + random() * 0.65
        });
      }
    }

    // Tiny raised tubercles over the central disc.
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = random() * 0.59;
      const position = new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        0.165 + random() * 0.018,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius
      );
      const normal = new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.cos(angle) * 0.18,
        1,
        Math.sin(angle) * 0.18
      ).normalize();

      spineData.push({
        position: position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.018, 0)),
        normal,
        scale: 0.55 + random() * 0.55
      });
    }

    const spineGeometry = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.027, 0.15, 6);
    const spines = new THREE.InstancedMesh(
      spineGeometry,
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x777369,
        map: brittleTextures.map,
        bumpMap: brittleTextures.bumpMap,
        bumpScale: 0.02,
        roughness: 0.95
      }),
      spineData.length
    );
    spines.castShadow = true;

    spineData.forEach((spine, index) => {
      transform.position.copy(spine.position);
      transform.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        spine.normal
      );
      transform.scale.setScalar(spine.scale);
      transform.updateMatrix();
      spines.setMatrixAt(index, transform.matrix);
    });

    scene.add(spines);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Ground
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(70, 70),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xdedbd1,
        roughness: 1,
        metalness: 0
      })
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -0.015;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls, implemented without external addons
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const cameraState = {
      yaw: 0.72,
      pitch: 0.57,
      distance: 13.8,
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 2.25, 0)
    };

    function updateCamera() {
      const horizontalDistance =
        cameraState.distance * Math.cos(cameraState.pitch);

      camera.position.set(
        cameraState.target.x +
          Math.sin(cameraState.yaw) * horizontalDistance,
        cameraState.target.y +
          Math.sin(cameraState.pitch) * cameraState.distance,
        cameraState.target.z +
          Math.cos(cameraState.yaw) * horizontalDistance
      );

      camera.lookAt(cameraState.target);
    }

    function resetCamera() {
      cameraState.yaw = 0.72;
      cameraState.pitch = 0.57;
      cameraState.distance = 13.8;
      updateCamera();
    }

    let dragging = false;
    let previousX = 0;
    let previousY = 0;

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      if (event.button !== 0) return;
      dragging = true;
      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;
      renderer.domElement.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    });

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!dragging) return;

      const deltaX = event.clientX - previousX;
      const deltaY = event.clientY - previousY;
      previousX = event.clientX;
      previousY = event.clientY;

      cameraState.yaw -= deltaX * 0.006;
      cameraState.pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
        cameraState.pitch + deltaY * 0.005,
        0.16,
        1.28
      );

      updateCamera();
    });

    function endDrag(event) {
      dragging = false;
      if (event.pointerId !== undefined) {
        if (renderer.domElement.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
          renderer.domElement.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        }
      }
    }

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointerup", endDrag);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDrag);

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        cameraState.distance = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          cameraState.distance * Math.exp(event.deltaY * 0.001),
          7.2,
          22
        );
        updateCamera();
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("dblclick", resetCamera);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener("contextmenu", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    window.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") cameraState.yaw += 0.08;
      if (event.key === "ArrowRight") cameraState.yaw -= 0.08;
      if (event.key === "ArrowUp") {
        cameraState.pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          cameraState.pitch + 0.06,
          0.16,
          1.28
        );
      }
      if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
        cameraState.pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          cameraState.pitch - 0.06,
          0.16,
          1.28
        );
      }
      if (event.key === "+" || event.key === "=") {
        cameraState.distance = Math.max(7.2, cameraState.distance - 0.5);
      }
      if (event.key === "-") {
        cameraState.distance = Math.min(22, cameraState.distance + 0.5);
      }
      updateCamera();
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = innerWidth / innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
    });

    updateCamera();

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Animation
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    });
  </script>
</body>
